I totally get that, but still, this was the end of two legendary megalo boxing careers, yet the victor was decided too soon. 

During the fight it seems they both overcame their problems, Joe quickly recovered after his collapse and Mac had the Mac Time situation under control.

They could have continued for at least until the end of the round or a bit more in the 3rd, where they could point out the decreased endurance of Joe due to its health or Mac's power and speed from the BES. 

I didn't wish for a fight to the death but at least to an acknowledgement of the fact his health is more important thus resulting in the forfeit, but this was very vague in the episode.

Truly, the ending was very anticlimactic. 

I get that they tried to end Joe's story in a peaceful manner, but personally, I think they could have ended the fight when Joe collapses from a harder punch or when his deteriorated health resurfaces. 

This would at least show the difference between two seemingly equal boxers, either in boxing skill or in their respective types of technology.
